outcome: contribution of different Robson's groups to overall cesarean section rate
cohort: All patients admitted beyond 20 weeks gestation in the Department of Obstetrics and Gynecology, Umaid Hospital, Jodhpur, India, between January 2012 and March 2012
finding: The overall cesarean section rate was 28.6%, with Group V (single, term, cephalic, previous CS) being the largest contributor (30.4%), followed by Groups I (nulliparous, single cephalic, spontaneous labour) and II (nulliparous, single cephalic, induced labour).
